title: Taiwanese American Student Association at Cornell
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Student Association at Cornell (TASA) is a registered student organization at Cornell University in Ithaca, New York. It is listed in Cornell’s official CampusGroups directory and recognized under the Cornell Asian Pacific Islander Student Union (CAPSU) umbrella, which coordinates Asian and Asian American student organizations on campus.

TASA focuses on Taiwanese American cultural community-building and is active in the ITASA (Intercollegiate Taiwanese American Students Association) national network. Its signature annual event is the Night Market, held in Duffield Hall, which features homemade Taiwanese cuisine, games modeled on Taiwan’s night market tradition, and performances by Cornell student groups. TASA has also co-hosted events with the Cornell Concert Commission and Cornell Asian Pacific Student Union, including a fall 2025 concert featuring Taiwanese American artist Sunkis.

TASA maintains an Instagram presence at @cornelltasa and is listed as an active organization in Cornell’s CampusGroups system as recently as November 2025. No dedicated standalone website was identified in first-party sources.
